tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “agency” has the meaning given the term in section 551 of title 5.

tree.heading: Indian tribe
tree.text: The term “Indian tribe” has the meaning given the term in section 5304 of this title.

tree.heading: Native Hawaiian organization
tree.text: The term “Native Hawaiian organization” means a nonprofit organization—

children.text: that serves the interests of Native Hawaiians;
in which Native Hawaiians serve in substantive and policymaking positions; and
that is recognized for having expertise in Native Hawaiian culture and heritage, including tourism.

tree.heading: Tribal organization
tree.text: The term “tribal organization” has the meaning given the term in section 5304 of this title.
